This evening, announcement for travelers
Please give it some attention
Companion Animal Travel Desk Notice

Travelers with pets need to check in with the Companion Animal Travel Desk before heading to the gate. Aurelia Skyways is keeping the process simple, but a quick stop at the desk helps avoid delays and keeps every trip smooth.

The desk team will review travel papers, carrier details, and basic boarding steps in a calm, practical way. If a pet needs a little extra care, the passenger coordinator will explain what to prepare and what to keep close during the journey. The welcome team also helps travelers understand how boarding works, so there are fewer surprises and less stress at the skyport.

Please bring your pet ready for a safe and comfortable trip, with everything packed and easy to reach. If something looks unclear, just ask the desk staff and they will point you in the right direction. We are here to keep the process friendly, steady, and plain.

Please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk before boarding.
